title: Secret Realm Entrance
next_chapter_hook: The blood pact inscription on the ancient stone tablet glowed with a faint light—those who entered must use their bloodline as a guide and sincerity as the key. Chen Ji gazed at those words, his eyes gleaming sharply, and already had a plan in mind.

text.content:
Dawn was breaking, yet the heavens had already undergone a sudden transformation.

Chen Ji stood atop the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate, the faint glow of the jade slip in his hand long extinguished. However, the lethal trap scene from Chapter 700 remained seared into his mind like a brand—sword light filling the sky, blood staining the heavens, and his own figure lying fallen in the midst of chaos.

"Three more days." He murmured softly, his fingertips caressing the cold surface of the jade slip. The warning from the Tianji Record was crystal clear: the lethal trap of Chapter 700 would come to fruition in the Secret Realm three days from now.

But what terrified him most was not the trap itself. It was that variable even the Tianji Record could not foresee—what was it? And where did it lurk?

Chen Ji raised his gaze toward the eastern horizon, already dyed crimson by the strange phenomenon.

"BOOM—"

A dull roar rang out from the east, as if the heavens had been torn apart. Chen Ji squinted his eyes to see the虚空 there beginning to twist and tear, a brilliantly dazzling golden light erupting from the crack and surging toward the clouds.

"Heavenly Dao phenomenon! The Secret Realm entrance is opening!"

Exclamations erupted from all directions. The Tianqing Sect instantly沸腾起来, disciples rushing toward the sect gate's edge, countless gazes fixed on that slowly forming golden light.

Chen Ji stood among the crowd, his expression calm as still water, but the hand hidden in his sleeve had quietly clenched.

Three days... he only had three days to set his pieces.

dialogue.content:
"Chen Ji."

A cold, clear voice came from behind. Chen Ji didn't need to turn to know who it was—Su Qingyao, the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow of the Tianqing Sect, and the only existence that made him feel threatened.

"Senior Sister Su." He turned around, respectfully bowing, his face wearing its usual timorous expression.

Su Qingyao's brow furrowed slightly, her gaze lingering on him for a moment, seemingly searching for flaws. "The Secret Realm opens today. As a core disciple, you must enter with the sect's team. The Sect Master's orders are absolute."

"This junior brother has noted it." Chen Ji replied, his voice carrying just the right amount of nervousness.

text.content:
Su Qingyao did not leave immediately; instead, she stood shoulder to shoulder with him, gazing at that increasingly bright golden light in the east. Her profile in the morning light was like an ice sculpture—beautiful yet distant.

"Within the Secret Realm, dangers are unpredictable." She suddenly spoke, her tone flat. "If you encounter crises beyond your capacity, you may seek me out."

Chen Ji was slightly stunned, raising his eyes to look at her. Hearing such words from Su Qingyao was truly unexpected. He knew this aloof Inner Disciple Senior Fellow had been secretly investigating him, yet he hadn't expected her to take the initiative to show goodwill.

"Thank you for Senior Sister Su's care." He withdrew his gaze, his voice still humble. "This junior brother... will be careful."

Su Qingyao said no more and turned to leave.

The moment Su Qingyao turned, Chen Ji caught the fleeting complex emotion in her eyes—a look not of mere wariness, but mixed with a thread of... concern?

"Getting more interesting." He laughed silently in his heart.

Tianqing Sect Master Ling Yuan 'coincidentally' passed by, patting Chen Ji's shoulder, his face full of kindness: "Ji'er, the Secret Realm expedition is extremely dangerous. Be careful in everything. If you encounter danger, retreat if needed—preserving your life is paramount."

"Thank you for the Sect Master's concern." Chen Ji expressed heartfelt gratitude, yet his heart was ice cold.

This old fox was indeed improving his acting skills.

The sun climbed higher, and the Eastern Heavenly Dao phenomenon became even more breathtaking.

The golden light tearing through the sky finally stabilized, transforming into a massive door of light, standing between heaven and earth. Within the door lay a hazy mist, with vague outlines of mountains and rivers visible, as if leading to another world.

"The Secret Realm entrance has opened!"

Cheers shook the heavens. Simultaneously, breaking-through-sky sounds came from the distant horizon—imperial dragon carriages, Demonic Path warships, flying vessels from other sects, densely packed, rushing toward this location.

All forces, gathered in one place.

Chen Ji stood among the crowd, his gaze focused. A true game of chess was about to begin.

dialogue.content:
"Young Master Chen, long time no see."

A pleasant voice rang in his ear, accompanied by a wisp of cold fragrance. Chen Ji glanced sideways to see a woman in black纱衣 had somehow appeared at his side, her enchanting figure visible yet hidden beneath the black纱.

Ye Qing. Holy Sect Saintess of the Demonic Path.

"Your Highness the Saintess." Chen Ji slightly nodded, his voice extremely low. "There are many eyes and ears here. Your Highness should not get too close to this one."

Ye Qing covered her lips and laughed lightly, yet her eyes held not a trace of amusement: "Young Master Chen, rest assured, this one knows her limits." She leaned close to his ear, her breath cold. "This Secret Realm expedition... you and I remain allies, yes?"

text.content:
Chen Ji did not answer, only nodding slightly.

Ye Qing's smile deepened. Just as she was about to speak further, an uproar erupted in the distance. Everyone looked to see a massive warship breaking through the sky, a sturdy young man standing at the bow, surrounded by scorching flames.

"The Xuanwu Sect has arrived!"

"That's... Han Lie! The number one genius of the Xuanwu Sect!"

Amidst exclamations, that young man leapt off the warship, striding toward this location. His gaze swept across the crowd and finally landed on Chen Ji, a contemptuous arc curving at the corner of his mouth.

"Oh, isn't this the 'waste' from the Tianqing Sect?" Han Lie's voice was thunderously loud, half the valley could hear. "Daring to come mess around in the Secret Realm? Not afraid of dying inside?"

Laughter erupted all around. The Xuanwu Sect disciples joined in the mockery, their gazes toward Chen Ji filled with mockery.

Chen Ji kept his head lowered, as if terrified by this show of force, his body trembling slightly.

Seeing this, Han Lie laughed even more brazenly: "Look at this cowardly appearance, truly embarrassing for the Tianqing Sect! If I were you, I'd find a piece of tofu and knocked myself dead—"

"Enough."

A cold, clear voice suddenly rang out. Su Qingyao had somehow appeared at Chen Ji's side, her icy gaze fixed straight on Han Lie: "The Secret Realm hasn't opened yet, Senior Brother Han. Bullying fellow cultivators like this—aren't you afraid of being ridiculed?"

Han Lie frowned, his expression slightly darkening. Being roughly equal in strength to Su Qingyao, he dared not be too presumptuous, so he could only snort coldly and look away.

Chen Ji still kept his head lowered, but the corner of his mouth slightly lifted.

This scene of Su Qingyao dressing down Han Lie happened to be witnessed by those around. The Inner Disciple Senior Fellow of the Tianqing Sect defending the waste—news of this would spread quickly.

Though it would bring him some trouble, the advantages outweighed the disadvantages. More importantly, Su Qingyao's actions made him even more certain of his judgment—this aloof Senior Sister had begun to develop some sort of... protective instinct toward him.

"Thank you, Senior Sister Su." He said softly, his voice carrying just the right amount of gratitude.

Su Qingyao glanced at him and said nothing.

At this moment, the light gate at the Secret Realm entrance had completely stabilized.

A majestic stone tablet rose from before the light gate, ancient and vast, covered with densely packed runes. At the very top, several blood-red characters were especially eye-catching:

"Those who enter must use bloodline as guide, sincerity as key."

"Bloodline? Sincerity?" Everyone debated, yet none could decipher its mystery.

Chen Ji gazed at those words, his eyes flickering. The Tianji Record seemed to contain records about this stone tablet, but the fragments were too incomplete; he could only vaguely recall some fragments.

Regardless, there must be something unusual within this Secret Realm.

dialogue.content:
Ye Qing's voice sounded in his ear again, this time carrying a hint of solemnity: "Young Master Chen, this one has sensed something amiss."

Chen Ji slightly tilted his head: "Oh?"

"Beneath this stone tablet, some ancient existence is sealed." Ye Qing lowered her voice, a flicker of fear crossing her eyes. "This one's Demonic Path mist can sense... it is a consciousness. A consciousness that has slumbered for ten thousand years."

Chen Ji's heart tightened, yet his expression remained unchanged: "Thank you for the Saintess's warning."

He gazed at that stone tablet, deep in thought. A consciousness dormant for ten thousand years... this seemed to echo the clues he had glimpsed from the Tianji Record fragments.

text.content:
Just as all forces were stirring restlessly, a commotion suddenly erupted at the edge of the crowd.

Chen Ji instinctively turned to look, his pupils abruptly contracting.

In the crowd, a familiar figure flashed past—a young woman in plain clothes, her appearance bearing five or six similarities to his own. She stood at the crowd's edge, seemingly searching for something, her gaze confused and anxious.

Chen Nian!

His heart clenched violently. His missing sister, his close kin taken by the Holy Sect as a 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key'—why would she appear here?!

But when he tried to look more closely, that figure had already vanished into the sea of people, as if it had never appeared.

text.content:
Ye Qing slightly nodded, a satisfied arc curving beneath her black纱. "Young Master Chen is indeed a wise man. Rest assured, this one will not disappoint you."

She quietly moved half a step closer to Chen Ji, the two standing shoulder to shoulder, looking from a distance like ordinary companions traveling together.

dialogue.content:
"Within the Secret Realm, mechanisms are numerous and重重." Ye Qing lowered her voice, her breath cold. "This one's Demonic Path mist can conceal our movements, but only for short distances. If we encounter strong enemies, the young master must handle them himself."

"No problem." Chen Ji replied calmly. "This one has his own discretion."

text.content:
A flicker of disappointment crossed Ye Qing's eyes, but it quickly vanished. She softly said, 'Since that is the case, please take care, young master. Within this secret realm, each of us must be careful.'

With that, she quietly retreated into the crowd, putting distance between herself and Chen Ji.

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji gazed at her departing figure, a slight sigh escaping his heart.

An alliance would indeed be secure, but it would also mean implicating Ye Qing in his own schemes. He was unwilling to owe too many favors—especially to this deep-thinking Demonic Path Saint.

'Acting alone would be more convenient for taking advantage of opportunities.' He murmured to himself, his gaze sweeping through the crowd, searching for that fleeting figure.

text.content:
'Buzz——'

The light gate suddenly emitted a long, resonant hum, and the runes on the stone tablet began to slowly illuminate, emitting a faint fluorescent glow.

'The secret realm has opened! Cultivators from all sides may enter and explore!'

A court official's voice resounded across the area. Various forces immediately stirred into commotion, and cultivators surged toward the light gate.

Chen Ji blended into the crowd, walking forward at an unhurried pace. His gaze constantly searched through the people, attempting to locate that familiar figure once more, but to no avail.

Chen Nian... why would you appear here?

Just as he was about to step into the light gate, a sharp gaze suddenly pierced his back.

Chen Ji's steps slightly faltered, but he didn't look back. He knew that gaze belonged to Su Qingyao—she had been secretly observing him all along, and today's scene would only deepen her suspicions.

'No matter.' He coldly smiled in his heart, 'Wait until you uncover the truth.'

Taking a deep breath, he stepped into the light gate.

In an instant, the world spun, and darkness filled his vision. When he opened his eyes again, he found himself in an unfamiliar valley.

Inside the secret realm, the sky was dim, and the air was filled with an ancient and desolate aura. In the distance, a continuous mountain range and deep canyons could be vaguely seen.

text.content:
Chen Ji didn't hesitate for long before quickly selecting a direction and darting toward the depths of the secret realm.

His movements appeared clumsy on the surface, but they concealed profound intricacies—each step perfectly avoiding any potential formations. This was the stepping technique recorded in the Tianji Record Fragment—appearing worthless on the surface, yet exquisitely refined.

text.content:
Chen Ji didn't rush deeper; instead, he found a secluded spot and took out the Tianji Record Fragment for careful study.

'Using bloodline as the guide, sincerity as the key...' he murmured to himself, 'What does this sentence actually mean?'

On the fragment, several blurred lines of text faintly appeared, seemingly connected to the stone tablet.

Just then, a familiar figure darted into the secret realm from the other side.

It was Ye Qing.

She landed not far from Chen Ji's side, as if she had already anticipated his appearance here. Seeing Chen Ji, she gave a slight nod, her face beneath the black veil carrying a hint of solemnity.

'Young Master Chen, this servant sensed that consciousness's fluctuation at the entrance.' She lowered her voice, 'It seems... it has awakened.'

Chen Ji's eyes turned cold. The Heavenly Dao's Eye? That transcendent consciousness, that terrifying existence that uses generations of prophets as chess pieces—could it have schemes within this secret realm?

dialogue.content:
Ye Qing moved closer, her voice dropped to an extreme whisper: 'This servant also sensed that consciousness's gaze... it seems to be注视着什么人.'

'注视着谁？'

'I don't know.' Ye Qing shook her head, a hint of fear flickering in her eyes, 'But that gaze was filled with... greed. Like looking at a delicacy about to be consumed.'

Chen Ji's heart sank.

He suddenly recalled a passage from the Tianji Record Fragment—generations of prophets would ultimately be devoured by the Heavenly Dao's Eye. Their destinies were predestined from the beginning.

And he, Chen Ji... could he also be among them?

text.content:
The blood pact inscription on the ancient stone tablet glowed with a ghostly light—those who enter must use bloodline as the guide, sincerity as the key.

Chen Ji gazed at those words, a sharp light flickering in his eyes as his mind immediately formed a strategy.

Using bloodline as the guide, sincerity as the key... are these eight characters truly the key to opening the secret realm, or some deeper conspiracy?

Regardless, the hidden dangers within this secret realm were far more terrifying than he had imagined. But at the same time, a bold plan was gradually taking shape in his heart—if he could exploit the variables within this secret realm, he might turn passivity into initiative, and turn the tables on those暗中窥伺的存在.

A slight smile curved Chen Ji's lips as he stepped forward.
